description.value:
Items seized from the remnants of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Once the switch is activated, it will automatically chant the "Thousand-Handed Merciful Medicus' Salvation."

"I hereby plant the sacred tree to liberate those living beings: So that life is boundless and old age never coming; death revitalizes; all troubles are dispelled."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. At the start of every creature's turn, including enemies, it regains hit points equal to its proficiency bonus. This ends after 5 rounds. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, all allies and enemies will restore 1000 HP at the start of the turn for the next battle, lasting for 5 turns.
